
 Usage: agentos vault [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

 Sealed vault: logins, TOTP seeds and API keys bound to domains and lanes.

╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --help          Show this message and exit.                                  │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Commands ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ init        Create the vault (vault.db plus a key file, or a passphrase).    │
│ unseal      Unseal the running daemon's vault (asks for the passphrase).     │
│ seal        Seal the running daemon's vault: the key is dropped from memory. │
│ status      Show whether the vault exists, its mode, entry count, and the    │
│             daemon's state.                                                  │
│ add         Add an entry. Secrets are prompted for (hidden) or read from     │
│             stdin, never from argv.                                          │
│ list        List entries: names, kinds, domains and lanes only.              │
│ show        Show an entry's metadata (never its username, secret or seed).   │
│ bind        Bind an entry to lanes (it resolves only on bound lanes).        │
│ unbind      Remove lane bindings from an entry.                              │
│ remove      Delete an entry for good.                                        │
│ catcher     Configure the code source of an entry: the email code catcher,   │
│             or the code card (--relay).                                      │
│             Codes are typed by the node, never shown.                        │
│ rotate-key  Re-seal every entry under a fresh data key; with --master,       │
│             replace the master key too.                                      │
│ import      Import an Apple Passwords, Bitwarden (unencrypted JSON),         │
│             1Password or generic CSV export.                                 │
│ mail        Mailboxes on this node: connect one in a minute, mail in and     │
│             out.                                                             │
│ git         Git credentials for lanes and brains: deploy keys and tokens     │
│             kept in the vault, and the remotes each workspace or lane may    │
│             fetch from and push to. See docs/GIT.md.                         │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
